requirements.requirement: Author Echo application logic, browser integration, orchestration and tests in plain-English Ernos. Use the working Ernos compiler and existing programs first. Upstream inference, training and protocol dependencies remain identified external dependencies; their language does not authorise rewriting Echo in Python, Rust or JavaScript.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate this exact requirement with final-build evidence; tool actions need positive execution, scope denial and applicable recovery checks.

requirements.requirement: Keep canonical source, models, preserved records and bulk artifacts on One Touch. Execute on the Mac, using internal runtime files and bounded caches where measured performance requires them. Track internal storage consumption and clean recoverable caches without deleting canonical data.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate this exact requirement with final-build evidence; tool actions need positive execution, scope denial and applicable recovery checks.

requirements.requirement: Local inference remains the default. The complete local core must work without internet. Discord, Gmail, web research and explicitly selected external inference necessarily communicate with their named services; they must not become hidden dependencies of offline chat.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate this exact requirement with final-build evidence; tool actions need positive execution, scope denial and applicable recovery checks.

requirements.requirement: Continue the multi-turn ReAct loop until completion, cancellation, required input or a recoverable failure. Do not impose arbitrary tool-turn, message-history or context limits.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate this exact requirement with final-build evidence; tool actions need positive execution, scope denial and applicable recovery checks.

requirements.requirement: Discover provider/model/runtime limits, tokenizer, modalities and output capacity. Resource scheduling may queue work or require an explicit pause; it must not silently shrink advertised context or discard history.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate this exact requirement with final-build evidence; tool actions need positive execution, scope denial and applicable recovery checks.

requirements.requirement: Preserve complete original conversation records, attachments, actual tool results and model-emitted reasoning. Compaction produces source-linked continuity state and keeps originals retrievable.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate this exact requirement with final-build evidence; tool actions need positive execution, scope denial and applicable recovery checks.
